description: List your resting orders on grades, newest first: a seller's asks (its active fixed-price listings on a grade, and its live token sell orders), a buyer's bids (its open intents on a grade, and its live token buy orders). Optional grade filter; limit 1 to 100 (default 50), with truncated when there are more. Each order carries kind and id for orders_cancel.

grade.description: Only orders on this grade (its slug).
